answer: A photoacoustic protocol curbs Sybil attacks among autonomous agents deployed in a citrus grove. Nodes prove physical embodiment by pulsing a violet emitter into a hollow acoustic cell to measure local gas resonance harmonics. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of fabricating discrete resonant chambers and microphones per identity rather than virtualizing software peers. However, ambient turbulence and temperature shifts distort acoustic waveforms, causing false rejections.
